ESTP>INTJ.title: You read the winning path while on the move, and plan many steps ahead.
ESTP>INTJ.body: Deciding things with clear logic is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you get energy from jumping in with people and also from quietly thinking things through alone. You can grab the facts in front of you and read the possibilities ahead. You can move lightly in the moment and also stick with a long plan. You take what you learn out in the field and turn it into a strategy that looks years ahead.
ESTP>INTJ.say: "I'll just go check it out first. …When I'm back, I'll turn it into a three-year plan."
ESTP>INTJ.do: On the way home from a free trial at a new gym, you've already mapped out six months of workouts in your head.
ESTP>INTJ.worry: You want to act and you want to plan, both strongly, so sometimes you can't decide when to start. Being with people is fun, but if you don't get time alone to think afterward, the tiredness doesn't go away.
ESTP>INTJ.karai: You say "I just went with my gut," but everyone knows you'd already planned three moves ahead.

ESTP>INTP.title: You use both street-smart instinct and a mind that thinks things all the way through.
ESTP>INTP.body: Thinking with logic and moving flexibly with the situation are your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you recharge both by hanging out with people and by sinking into your thoughts alone. You trust the facts you can touch, and you're curious about the "why" behind how things work. You're the kind of person who takes apart a broken gadget and ends up talking about how it works all night.
ESTP>INTP.say: "Let's just open it up. …Oh, wait, this mechanism is actually really cool."
ESTP>INTP.do: On a trip with friends, you skip the famous local food because you can't stop staring at how an old water wheel works.
ESTP>INTP.worry: You go out the moment someone invites you, then feel drained on the way home because you didn't get enough time alone. You love thinking so much that sometimes you're satisfied with the idea in your head before you even start.
ESTP>INTP.karai: You head out "to have fun" and spend the whole time figuring out how something works.

ESTP>ENTJ.title: You take the path you opened with sheer momentum and grow it into a big plan.
ESTP>ENTJ.body: Getting energy from people and deciding with logic are the same in your temperament and your character. Added to that, you can grab the facts in front of you fast and also picture what's possible ahead. You can react on the spot and also work backward from the goal to set up the steps. You're the one at the front of the team putting out fires, while quietly getting the next move ready.
ESTP>ENTJ.say: "So three of us can move right now. …And next year, let's take this nationwide."
ESTP>ENTJ.do: When someone suddenly can't make it, you're the first to fill the gap, and by that night you've proposed a system so it never happens again.
ESTP>ENTJ.worry: The more you look ahead, the harder it is to resist jumping at the fun thing right in front of you. Other people's pace can feel slow, so you end up pulling everyone along by yourself.
ESTP>ENTJ.karai: By the time you say "Let's decide together," you've already decided.

ESTP>ENTP.title: You turn real-world experience into one new idea after another.
ESTP>ENTP.body: Getting energy from people, thinking with logic, and moving with the situation are your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you can stand firmly on solid facts and also look toward things no one has tried yet. You think about "what will actually happen" and "how could this be more fun" at the same time. That's why you're the one with the most ideas in any meeting.
ESTP>ENTP.say: "Last time we did this, it really brought people in. …But what if we flipped it? Wouldn't that be even better?"
ESTP>ENTP.do: For the school festival, you pull out last year's sales records and pitch three brand-new ideas.
ESTP>ENTP.worry: You want to try every idea you have, so you end up with too many things started. When a debate gets heated, you win the argument and then feel a little awkward.
ESTP>ENTP.karai: Your "I was just thinking…" usually lasts about thirty minutes.

ESTP>INFJ.title: You can turn deep insight into action without hesitating.
ESTP>INFJ.body: Day to day, you're a thoughtful person who looks closely at what's in people's hearts and what things really mean. But once you see it, you don't stop there. The moment you feel "now," your body moves, with lightness and nerve. You're not just a thinker, and not just a doer. You see what matters before others notice, and take the first step while everyone else is still unsure.
ESTP>INFJ.say: "I just have a feeling they're having a hard time. …Okay, I'm going to go see them now."
ESTP>INFJ.do: After thinking about a job change for weeks, you wake up one morning, decide "today's the day," and get moving that same day.
ESTP>INFJ.worry: You want to think things through and you want to act right away, both at once, so sometimes neither feels finished. You see people's feelings so clearly that you're worn out after you act.
ESTP>INFJ.karai: You say "I want to think it over carefully," but you've usually already signed up.

ESTP>INFP.title: You move lightly and quickly, carrying a gentle heart with you.
ESTP>INFP.body: Moving flexibly with the situation is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you get energy from people and also from quietly holding your feelings close. You trust solid facts and you love to imagine. You can decide calmly with logic, and you care deeply about feelings. You act the moment an idea hits, yet there's always "for someone" or "for something I care about" behind it.
ESTP>INFP.say: "I can go right now! …I just don't want to do anything she'd hate, though."
ESTP>INFP.do: The same day you hear a friend is struggling, you buy what they need and drop it off at their door.
ESTP>INFP.worry: You can act boldly, but when you do something that doesn't fit your heart, it slowly starts to hurt later. On days you've spent going along with others, you need time alone to settle your feelings.
ESTP>INFP.karai: You say "It didn't mean anything," but what you do usually means a lot.

ESTP>ENFJ.title: You have in-the-moment drive and an eye for helping people grow.
ESTP>ENFJ.body: Getting energy from people is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you can see facts quickly and also believe in what people and things could become. You decide calmly with logic and care warmly about feelings. You can react on the spot and also plan ahead to keep things moving. On a team, you brighten the mood and still keep an eye on how each person is growing.
ESTP>ENFJ.say: "Let's go all out at practice today! …And after, let's talk one-on-one."
ESTP>ENFJ.do: You turn a younger teammate's mistake into a laugh on the spot, then later quietly share a tip to get it right.
ESTP>ENFJ.worry: The more you act for everyone else, the more your own wishes get pushed back. Even when you want to decide quickly, you wait for others' feelings, and your decision gets delayed.
ESTP>ENFJ.karai: You give advice to everyone and have no one to go to yourself.

ESTP>ENFP.title: You use real action to spread new ideas and bring people together.
ESTP>ENFP.body: Getting energy from people and moving lightly with the situation are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you trust the facts in front of you and get excited about what hasn't happened yet. You decide calmly with logic and care warmly about feelings. You don't just talk about ideas. You say "Let's try it tomorrow" and actually get people together.
ESTP>ENFP.say: "That would be so much fun! …Okay, I'll lock in the place and the headcount."
ESTP>ENFP.do: Someone at dinner says "We should take a trip sometime," and by the next morning you've made a group chat with dates.
ESTP>ENFP.worry: There's so much fun stuff that your schedule and energy are always stretched to the limit. Even when you want to decide with logic, you picture someone's disappointed face and hesitate.
ESTP>ENFP.karai: You don't allow "someday," so your friends' jokes usually come true.

ESTP>ISTJ.title: You have both quick thinking and steady, honest reliability.
ESTP>ISTJ.body: Relying on facts and experience and deciding with logic are your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you get energy from people and also recharge calmly alone. You can adapt on the spot and also follow the steps you've set. Usually you're the dependable one who respects the rules, but when it counts, you're the fastest to decide and move.
ESTP>ISTJ.say: "Let's follow the plan. …But if it rains, we switch to the backup right away."
ESTP>ISTJ.do: You take the same train every morning, but the second there's a delay, you've already found the fastest way around.
ESTP>ISTJ.worry: You want to prepare properly, but when every day is the same, you get restless. After a lively time with people, you can't relax until you've quietly tidied up alone.
ESTP>ISTJ.karai: You say "Let's stick to the plan," but you're the best at improvising.

ESTP>ISFJ.title: You quietly support the people around you, ready to jump in at any moment.
ESTP>ISFJ.body: Relying on the facts and experience in front of you is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you get energy from people and also feel calm in time alone. You decide calmly with logic and stay gentle with people's feelings. You can move lightly in the moment and also build things up with care. When you see someone in trouble, your hands move before your words, and you sort it out smoothly.
ESTP>ISFJ.say: "I'll carry that. …Oh, and I got tomorrow's stuff ready too."
ESTP>ISFJ.do: Helping a friend move, you carry the heaviest boxes and still bring drinks and snacks for everyone.
ESTP>ISFJ.worry: Because you can help people so quickly, your schedule fills up with favors before you know it. Even on days you want to fully relax, you feel you should stay on top of things and hesitate to rest.
ESTP>ISFJ.karai: Your catchphrase is "It was nothing," but it's usually quite a lot.

ESTP>ESTJ.title: You turn your speed in the field into systems that really work.
ESTP>ESTJ.body: Getting energy from people, valuing facts, and deciding with logic are your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you can move right away with the situation and also plan ahead and see things through. When trouble hits, you deal with it on the spot, and afterward you set up the rules for "next time, let's do it this way." You're a leader who shines on the ground.
ESTP>ESTJ.say: "I'll go handle it. …When I'm back, let's rewrite the manual."
ESTP>ESTJ.do: You plan a barbecue down to the last detail, and the moment it rains, you switch everyone to a covered spot.
ESTP>ESTJ.worry: Sometimes you want people to follow the rules, and sometimes you want to move without caring about rules at all, and switching between the two wears you out. You move things along so briskly that you worry people find you "a little scary."
ESTP>ESTJ.karai: The first person to break the rules you made is probably you.

ESTP>ESFJ.title: You use your energy to make a place where everyone belongs.
ESTP>ESFJ.body: Getting energy from people and valuing what's real in front of you are the same in your temperament and your character. On top of that, you make clean, logical calls and also pay close attention to people's feelings. You can move lightly in the moment and also prepare ahead so no one is left stuck. At gatherings, you're both the life of the party and the host, and by the end you know everyone's face and name.
ESTP>ESFJ.say: "Okay, cheers! …Oh, do you guys over there have enough to drink?"
ESTP>ESFJ.do: At the neighborhood festival, you quickly settle prices with the stalls, then spend the rest of the day playing with the kids.
ESTP>ESFJ.worry: Even when you want to say something clearly, you sometimes hold it in because you don't want to spoil the mood. When you put everyone's needs first, you run out of room to enjoy yourself.
ESTP>ESFJ.karai: Whenever you organize the dinner, you're the one who barely eats.

ESTP>ISTP.title: You have both quick, hands-on instinct and quiet focus.
ESTP>ISTP.body: Relying on facts, thinking with logic, and moving flexibly are your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you get energy from being with people and also recharge by getting absorbed in something on your own. You love going out with friends, but you also feel full tinkering alone with your bike or guitar. You're someone with real skill in your hands.
ESTP>ISTP.say: "Let's all go sometime. …Actually, I'll check it out by myself first."
ESTP>ISTP.do: At camp, you quietly get the fire going on the first try, then become the loudest one there.
ESTP>ISTP.worry: There's a big gap between days you love being surrounded by people and days you don't want anyone to talk to you, which can confuse those around you. You find it a bit hard to explain your ups and downs.
ESTP>ISTP.karai: For someone who "likes being alone," you sure show up whenever you're invited.

ESTP>ISFP.title: You move with bold energy and a soft, gentle sense of beauty.
ESTP>ISFP.body: Valuing the facts and feelings in front of you, and moving lightly with the situation, are your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you get energy from people and also from losing yourself in what you love alone. You can make clean, logical calls and also treasure your feelings and tastes. Wherever you dive in on impulse, you come back having found something beautiful no one else noticed.
ESTP>ISFP.say: "Let's go see! …Wow, this sunset. Hold on, let me take a picture."
ESTP>ISFP.do: You wander into a vintage shop on a whim, become friends with the staff, and leave with a one-of-a-kind piece.
ESTP>ISFP.worry: Even when you want to stay cool about something, your likes and dislikes show on your face. After a fun time with people, you can't settle down without time alone doing what you love.
ESTP>ISFP.karai: You seem to do everything on impulse, but you never compromise on the taste of your stuff.

ESTP>ESTP.title: You've opened up every situation with a fast first step.
ESTP>ESTP.body: Your temperament and your character are the same type. You move before you overthink, catch the flow of the moment, and never miss the key chance. That strength has grown steadily since you were a child. Because you know so clearly who you are, you shine in places full of change, and in places where you just have to wait, you can wear down without knowing why.
ESTP>ESTP.say: "Hesitating is a waste of time. Let's go."
ESTP>ESTP.do: When you get lost on a trip, you skip the map, ask a local, and come away with a restaurant tip too.
ESTP>ESTP.worry: Thinking ahead gets pushed back, and deadlines or important paperwork give you a scare. When dull days drag on, your energy drops and you can't tell why.
ESTP>ESTP.karai: Your "later" usually means the morning it's due.

ESTP>ESFP.title: You have calm judgment and a friendly warmth that lights up the room.
ESTP>ESFP.body: Getting energy from people, enjoying what's real in front of you, and moving with the moment are your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you can quickly weigh the pros and cons with logic and also warm up the room by caring about people's feelings. You keep the fun going while calmly reading the flow in the back of your mind, and when it matters, you take charge in a snap.
ESTP>ESFP.say: "Yes, let's have fun! …But let's figure out the last train home first."
ESTP>ESFP.do: At a friend's surprise birthday, you're the most excited one there, and you still split the bill down to the last cent on the spot.
ESTP>ESFP.worry: You don't want to break the happy mood, so you wrap what needs saying in a joke. After you say something straight, you worry you might have hurt the other person.
ESTP>ESFP.karai: You were the wildest one there, and on the way home you can list every lesson from the night.

ESFP>INTJ.title: You can add cheer that makes people smile to a careful, detailed plan.
ESFP>INTJ.body: Day to day, you're a calm strategist who's good at looking ahead and planning with logic. But deep down, there's a sunny side that loves this very moment and brightens everyone around you. So your plans aren't just right, they're actually fun. You map out the path with a cool head and bring people along with a warm smile.
ESFP>INTJ.say: "Here's how I set up the whole flow. …And I made time at the end for all of us to celebrate."
ESFP>INTJ.do: You plan a trip down to the minute, slip in one "free time, no plans" slot, and that's when you have the most fun.
ESFP>INTJ.worry: You want to get things done efficiently and you want to enjoy the mood of the moment, so you can't decide how to spend your day off. After a fun time with people, you lose your rhythm if you don't get quiet time alone to reset.
ESFP>INTJ.karai: The most important item on your perfect schedule is probably "the after-party."

ESFP>INTP.title: You use both a friendly, open heart and a mind that thinks deeply.
ESFP>INTP.body: Moving flexibly with the situation is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you get energy from people and also from getting lost in thought alone. You enjoy the moment with all your senses and love digging into how things work. You care warmly about feelings and can sort things out calmly with logic. In the middle of a fun chat, you're the one who suddenly asks, "Wait, why does that happen?"
ESFP>INTP.say: "This shop is so cute! …Hey, why does this layout make me want to buy stuff?"
ESFP>INTP.do: At an amusement park, you enjoy the rides while endlessly thinking about how the lines move.
ESFP>INTP.worry: You love talking with people, but when you get caught up in thought, you forget to reply to messages. Even when feelings matter most, you answer with logic and regret it later.
ESFP>INTP.karai: Your reply to "That was fun!" tends to be "Yeah, the mechanics were interesting."

ESFP>ENTJ.title: You use your sunny energy to lead everyone toward big goals.
ESFP>ENTJ.body: Getting energy from people is your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you savor the fun right in front of you and also picture what's possible ahead. You care warmly about feelings and decide calmly with logic. You can go with the flow and also work backward from the goal. Even when you set a high target, people somehow follow with a smile. You're a leader who's easy to be around.
ESFP>ENTJ.say: "Our goal is 1.5 times last year! …If we hit it, we're all going out for barbecue."
ESFP>ENTJ.do: After firmly setting the numbers in a meeting, you hand out snacks to every member.
ESFP>ENTJ.worry: The more you want results, the more you worry about someone's feelings after you speak harshly. When your head is full of future plans, you lose the room to enjoy what's in front of you.
ESFP>ENTJ.karai: You say "Let's have fun with it," but you've even set targets for the fun.

ESFP>ENTP.title: You use your cheerful vibe to keep growing new ideas.
ESFP>ENTP.body: Getting energy from people and moving lightly with the moment are the same in your temperament and your character. Added to that, you enjoy the present with all your senses and dream up things that don't exist yet. You care warmly about feelings and dig in sharply with logic. While making everyone laugh, you turn the conversation into a plan with "What if we did it like this? Wouldn't that be more fun?"
ESFP>ENTP.say: "Ooh, that sounds fun! …But wait, if we did it the other way, it might be even better."
ESFP>ENTP.do: While getting ready for a friend's birthday party, you keep adding ideas until it's turned into a small event.
ESFP>ENTP.worry: You jump at every fun idea, and half-finished things pile up. After a heated debate, you check people's faces, worried you went too far.
ESFP>ENTP.karai: Somehow, every idea you pitch as a joke ends up actually happening.

ESFP>INFJ.title: You have both a bright side that entertains people and the depth to see into their hearts.
ESFP>INFJ.body: Deciding with care for people's feelings is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you get energy from people and also settle your heart quietly alone. You enjoy the fun in front of you and can read the meaning behind things. You can go with the flow and also look ahead and prepare. Even while enjoying a lively crowd, you're the first to notice who looks lonely.
ESFP>INFJ.say: "Let's all take a picture! …Wait, Sam's not in it. Come over here!"
ESFP>INFJ.do: On the way home from a fun get-together, you think, "They seemed worried about something," and quietly send a message the next day.
ESFP>INFJ.worry: You love seeing people, but afterward your heart feels more tired than you expected. You read people's feelings so deeply that you worry about things that haven't even happened.
ESFP>INFJ.karai: The days you laugh the loudest are the days you think the hardest.

ESFP>INFP.title: You savor the present and treasure the feelings in your heart.
ESFP>INFP.body: Caring about feelings and moving flexibly with the situation are your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you get energy from people and also from quietly holding your feelings close. You can sense the beauty and fun right in front of you, and imagine what can't be seen yet. After a fun day out with friends, you can tuck that day's scenery away in your heart like a little poem.
ESFP>INFP.say: "Today was so much fun! …I kind of want to remember the color of this sky forever."
ESFP>INFP.do: After a trip, you make an album and add a few short words to each photo, one by one.
ESFP>INFP.worry: Time with friends and time alone in your imagination both matter to you, so you swing between overbooking and hiding away. You can't always put what you care about into words, and that's frustrating.
ESFP>INFP.karai: You say "I just go with the flow," but you're more stubborn about what you like than anyone.

ESFP>ENFJ.title: You enjoy the moment and give people a warm push forward.
ESFP>ENFJ.body: Getting energy from people and deciding with care for feelings are your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you enjoy this very moment and believe in what people can become. You can ride the flow and also look ahead and guide everyone. When a friend says "I want to try this," you get excited with them, and before you know it, you've planned how to support them.
ESFP>ENFJ.say: "That's such a great idea! …So let's try it once by next month. I'll help."
ESFP>ENFJ.do: You rush to a younger friend's performance with flowers, and afterward you help them think about their next goal.
ESFP>ENFJ.worry: You love being helpful, so you can't say no, and your schedule gets packed. The more you plan for everyone else, the less time you have to just enjoy yourself.
ESFP>ENFJ.karai: Your schedule for cheering on other people's dreams is perfect. Your own dream? "Someday."

ESFP>ENFP.title: You chase both the fun in front of you and ideas that keep growing.
ESFP>ENFP.body: Getting energy from people, caring about feelings, and moving with the moment are your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you can fully enjoy the present with all your senses and also picture a future that doesn't exist yet, thinking "wouldn't that be lovely." You treasure today's fun and still find the excitement beyond it, so you brighten the days of everyone around you.
ESFP>ENFP.say: "This cake is so good! …Hey, want to open a shop together someday?"
ESFP>ENFP.do: Halfway through a café-hopping day, you come up with a small event just for your group and invite your friends on the spot.
ESFP>ENFP.worry: The fun things and things you want to try keep piling up, and your body and time can't keep up. You want to reach for both today's fun and tomorrow's dreams, so narrowing it down to one is hard.
ESFP>ENFP.karai: Your "someday" list is already longer than one lifetime.

ESFP>ISTJ.title: You put your friendly cheer to work with steady, solid effort.
ESFP>ISTJ.body: Relying on facts and experience is your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you get energy from people and also calm down alone. You care warmly about feelings and decide calmly with logic. You can enjoy the moment and also move forward steadily, step by step. At work, people count on you as "the reliable one," and on breaks you're the one making everyone laugh.
ESFP>ISTJ.say: "I'll finish the documents today. …After that, want to check out the new bakery?"
ESFP>ISTJ.do: You write careful handover notes, then add a handwritten line at the end: "Ask me anytime if you get stuck."
ESFP>ISTJ.worry: The better you do, the more people rely on you, and you get fewer chances to just goof around. After you decide based on what's right, you wonder if you left someone's feelings behind.
ESFP>ISTJ.karai: Your face says serious work. Your mind is mostly on weekend plans.

ESFP>ISFJ.title: You support the everyday lives of those around you with bright, thoughtful care.
ESFP>ISFJ.body: Valuing what's real in front of you and deciding with care for people's feelings are your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you get energy from people and also feel relief in time alone. You can enjoy the moment lightly and also prepare ahead with steady care. At gatherings, you're the one keeping the fun going, and you've already prepared everything to match everyone's tastes.
ESFP>ISFJ.say: "Let's go all out tonight! …Oh, Alex can't really drink, so I got some juice too."
ESFP>ISFJ.do: At a house party, you laugh the most, and as people leave, you hand each one a little bag of treats.
ESFP>ISFJ.worry: You want so much to make people happy that you put too much into preparing, and you're exhausted by the day itself. After a fun time, you need to rest quietly alone to get your energy back.
ESFP>ISFJ.karai: Everyone's gifts are perfect, but you forgot to get one for yourself.

ESFP>ESTJ.title: You make things fun and still move them forward properly.
ESFP>ESTJ.body: Getting energy from people and valuing what's real in front of you are the same in your temperament and your character. Added to that, you have the brightness to liven up any moment and the sense of responsibility to plan things and see them through. When asked to organize a group dinner, you get the place and budget perfect, and then you're the one having the most fun on the night.
ESFP>ESTJ.say: "Okay, we meet at 7. …So, where are we going after?"
ESFP>ESTJ.do: You make a detailed trip guide, then find an interesting shop when you get there and change the whole plan.
ESFP>ESTJ.worry: The more people rely on you as "so dependable," the less time you get to just play. You want to stick to what you decided and you also want to enjoy the moment, so days off can be the most tiring.
ESFP>ESTJ.karai: Your schedule is perfect. You just forgot to pencil in time for your own fun.

ESFP>ESFJ.title: You enjoy the moment and take good care of everyone's circle.
ESFP>ESFJ.body: Getting energy from people and caring about what's real and how people feel are your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you can go with the fun of the moment and also look ahead to prepare so no one is left stuck. For events and celebrations, you take on both the planning and the caring, and on the day, you truly enjoy it too. You're a host people can count on.
ESFP>ESFJ.say: "Okay, that's the plan for the day! …But if something looks fun, we can change it, right?"
ESFP>ESFJ.do: You carefully handle the guest list and venue for a class reunion, then get the most excited sharing old memories on the day.
ESFP>ESFJ.worry: You make rules so everyone can have a good time, but on the day itself, you want to go with the flow. The more you try to meet people's expectations, the harder it gets to say you're tired.
ESFP>ESFJ.karai: You're great at telling others "Don't push yourself." You just can't say it to yourself.

ESFP>ISTP.title: You have both a bright, friendly warmth and quiet skill.
ESFP>ISTP.body: Valuing the facts and feelings in front of you and moving lightly with the situation are your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you get energy from people and also from quietly focusing on something alone. You care warmly about feelings and can make clean, logical calls. You love laughing with everyone, but you also feel quietly full when you're lost in cooking or making something alone.
ESFP>ISTP.say: "Ooh, that looks fun, I'm in! …Here, let me see. It's faster if you do it like this."
ESFP>ISTP.do: When a friend's bike gets a flat, you crack jokes while fixing it in no time.
ESFP>ISTP.worry: Wanting to be kind and wanting to keep things simple bump into each other, and you're not sure how to say things. After a run of lively days, a day comes when you suddenly don't want to talk to anyone.
ESFP>ISTP.karai: When someone says "You can do anything!" you get shy and change the subject right away.

ESFP>ISFP.title: You love entertaining people and treasure your own sense of beauty.
ESFP>ISFP.body: Sensing the beauty and fun in front of you, caring about feelings, and moving flexibly are your core, in both your temperament and your character. On top of that, you light up around people and also fill your heart by losing yourself in what you love alone. Laughing with friends out and about, and being surrounded by your favorite music or art in your room, are both things your days can't do without.
ESFP>ISFP.say: "Let's all go! …Oh, but I might want to walk home alone, nice and slow."
ESFP>ISFP.do: After a lively group dinner, you stop by a park at night on your own and walk home listening to your favorite songs.
ESFP>ISFP.worry: Invitations make you happy, so you say yes too often and later run short of time for yourself. You use so much energy keeping the mood bright that you miss the chance to talk about what you love.
ESFP>ISFP.karai: You look so social, but you've firmly booked your "alone time" too.

ESFP>ESTP.title: You have a kind heart for people and the cool head to spot the key moment.
ESFP>ESTP.body: Getting energy from people, enjoying what's real in front of you, and moving with the moment are your core, in both your temperament and your character. Added to that, you can warm up the room by caring about feelings and also quickly decide by weighing the pros and cons with logic. You laugh with everyone, and the moment trouble hits, you're the fastest to calmly fix it. You're the fun one people can count on.
ESFP>ESTP.say: "It's fine, it's fine! …Okay, let's grab a table at another place while we can."
ESFP>ESTP.do: When the hotel booking falls through on a trip, you keep everyone laughing while you call around and find another place.
ESFP>ESTP.worry: After making a practical decision, you keep replaying how the other person might have felt. You often decide on impulse, so checking the small details gets pushed back.
ESFP>ESTP.karai: You're so sensitive to people's feelings, and so clueless about what's in your wallet.

ESFP>ESFP.title: You've grown your gift for lighting up any room, straight and true.
ESFP>ESFP.body: Your temperament and your character are the same type. Your gift for enjoying the moment with others and brightening everyone's mood has grown steadily since you were little. Because you know so clearly who you are, you come alive in places full of connection, and in places where you work alone in silence, you can lose your spark without knowing why.
ESFP>ESFP.say: "We're here anyway, so let's enjoy it!"
ESFP>ESFP.do: Even at a gathering full of strangers, you end up laughing in the middle of it all and go home with a bunch of new contacts.
ESFP>ESFP.worry: While you put fun first, money and future plans can slip. When you feel low, it's often not because you're weak, but because you've been too far from people.
ESFP>ESFP.karai: The night you say "This month I'm really saving money," you usually buy something.
